jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at KAPITAL is a full-time remote role responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing the organization’s information security strategy. The CISO will lead the development and maintenance of security policies, standards, and procedures, and ensure alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day tasks include assessing security risks, directing incident response, overseeing security monitoring and threat detection, and coordinating audits and compliance activities. The CISO will collaborate with technology, operations, and business teams to embed security controls into applications, infrastructure, and processes, and will provide regular reports and guidance to senior leadership on security posture and risk. This role also includes managing vendor and third-party security risk, leading security awareness initiatives, and driving continuous improvement in cybersecurity practices across the organization.
Qualifications

Strong expertise in Information Security and Information Security Management, including policy development, risk management, and governance frameworks.
Proficiency in Cybersecurity practices such as threat detection, incident response, security monitoring, and vulnerability management.
Experience with Application Security, including secure software development lifecycle (SDLC), code review, and integration of security controls into applications and services.
Knowledge of Business Continuity planning, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies to ensure ongoing operations during and after security events.
Proven leadership experience in senior security or technology roles, with the ability to build and mentor diverse, distributed teams.
Familiarity with relevant regulations and standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR or other data protection frameworks as applicable).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence executive decision-making.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree or industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP) are beneficial.
Experience working in remote or globally distributed environments and managing security across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructures.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, CTEM & Vulnerability Intelligence - Remote
jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, CTEM & Vulnerability Management, you will lead the enterprise Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and Vulnerability Management function across enterprise IT, cloud, operational technology (OT), and product environments. You will partner with Product Security, Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Engineering teams to reduce exposure through risk-based discovery, prioritization, validation, and remediation.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

Lead the enterprise CTEM and Vulnerability Management program, including its strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Oversee vulnerability scanning and assessment across infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, identity, network, and OT environments.
Manage the product security vulnerability lifecycle with Product Security, including intake, triage, risk assessment, remediation tracking, software bill of materials (SBOM) analysis, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure support.
Prioritize vulnerabilities and exposures using CVSS, EPSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business context.
Lead attack surface management, exposure validation, and breach and attack simulation activities to confirm exploitability and control effectiveness.
Evaluate emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, and threat intelligence affecting enterprise systems, marketed products, and embedded systems.
Drive automation for vulnerability discovery, data enrichment, ticketing, remediation workflows, and reporting through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.
Support cyber incident investigations with vulnerability context, exposure analysis, and remediation expertise.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Product Security, and Engineering teams to establish risk-based service-level agreements, drive remediation, and track plans of action and milestones.
Establish governance standards, quality assurance procedures, and documentation for vulnerability and exposure management operations.
Measure and report exposure reduction, remediation performance, validation results, and operational metrics to executive stakeholders.
Lead vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Analyze complex vulnerability data and large volumes of exposure telemetry to identify risk and guide response.
Translate technical findings, remediation status, and risk trends into clear written, verbal, and presentation-ready updates for technical and executive audiences.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity.
Minimum 3 years of experience leading vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.
Experience managing product vulnerabilities, including triage, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, SBOM analysis, and remediation with product engineering teams.
Experience with Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or equivalent vulnerability and exposure management technologies.
Experience implementing automation through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
CISSP, CISM, GEVA, GPEN, GIAC, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent professional certification.

Lead executive briefings, stakeholder updates, reporting, communication cadence, and documentation of significant decisions.
Coordinate response with crisis, communications, legal, privacy, human resources, procurement, continuity, and technology operations teams.
Lead executive tabletop, functional, and technical exercises; maintain the roadmap and close corrective actions.
Lead post-incident reviews and incorporate technical findings and root-cause lessons into playbooks and readiness activities.
Build CIRT leadership depth through coaching, exercises, structured development, and clear performance expectations.

Apply incident response, recovery, crisis communications, business continuity, and crisis coordination practices during high-pressure events.
Translate issues into business terms and coordinate concurrent workstreams using risk-based decisions.

Vice President of Technology | PE-Backed Route-Based Services Platform

The Talent Source is thrilled to lead the search for a Vice President of Technology
for a newly independent, private equity-backed route-based services business entering its next phase of growth.

This is a unique opportunity for a technology leader who wants to build, not simply inherit
.
Following a corporate carve-out, the VP of Technology will have the opportunity to establish the technology organization and operating model, build the appropriate internal capabilities, and strategically leverage partners to create a secure, scalable technology foundation.
Just as importantly, this leader will partner with the executive team to define how technology, digital, data and AI can transform the operating model and customer experience
of a geographically distributed, route-based services organization.

The Opportunity

The VP of Technology will own a broad transformation agenda, including:
Building the standalone technology organization, operating model and roadmap
Digitally enabling field operations, including scheduling, dispatch, route optimization and technician productivity
Leveraging field technology and digital tools to transform the customer experience
, providing customers with greater visibility into the work performed, service outcomes and value delivered
Advancing CRM, field service and enterprise application capabilities
Building a trusted data and analytics foundation to improve operational and commercial decision-making
Identifying practical applications of AI
that can drive productivity, customer experience, pricing, sales and operating performance
Creating a scalable technology platform capable of supporting continued organic growth and future acquisitions

The Leader we are Looking For

We are particularly interested in technology leaders who have successfully digitally enabled a route-based, field services or highly distributed services organization
.
Relevant backgrounds may include home and trade services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control, landscaping, environmental services, facilities services, commercial maintenance, waste/recycling, equipment services or other recurring field-service models.

The successful candidate will bring a combination of:
Proven technology and digital transformation leadership within a distributed services environment
Experience improving field operations and customer experience through technology
A track record of building or materially transforming a technology organization
Strong data, analytics and emerging AI fluency

Commercial orientation, with the ability to connect technology investment to productivity, growth, margin and enterprise value
The ability to move comfortably between the executive team and Board and the operational realities of employees working in the field
Experience in a PE-backed, carve-out or acquisitive environment is highly desirable

Location & Compensation

The role offers some geographic flexibility. Southeast U.S. locations are preferred
to facilitate regular collaboration with the leadership team, with consideration also given to candidates based in major markets with strong travel connectivity, including Dallas, North Carolina and Philadelphia
.

This opportunity offers an attractive compensation package including base, bonus and LTI participation. This is an opportunity to create the technology capability, shape the digital agenda and directly influence the value-creation journey
of a growing services platform.

to learn more.
